title: Set Catppuccin as the default theme for the demo site
description: Once all Omarchy/Antharchy themes are supported, update the demo site to use the 'catppuccin' theme as the default.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Set Catppuccin as default theme for demo site:
- Updated build_site and _wrap_page in sitebuild.py to default to 'catppuccin'.
- Added data-theme attribute and stylesheet link pre-rendering with catppuccin default.
- Added theme: catppuccin to demo site pages (index.md, gallery.md, gfm.md).
- Added styling for theme switcher in site.css.
- Added BDD feature scenario to features/site.feature and verified with behave (143 scenarios passing) and ruff lint.
